description: This file defines the class MessageOnlyLogFilter, which implements a LogNode interface. It filters logs by passing only the message content to the next node in the chain, removing other metadata. It's used for simplified on-screen logging.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class implementing LogNode that forwards only message content to the next LogNode.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter(LogNode next)
methods.description: Constructor accepting the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println(int priority, String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)
methods.description: Filters logs to pass only messages to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode node)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
